title: 第19章 时间就是金钱第20章 敲定框架
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 思忖了片刻。
罗德抬笔在西边的箭头写下了“农田”二字。
随即认真看向查尔和布莱斯。
“我的想法是全年精耕5000~7000亩地。”
所有地都按照播种时节来分开耕种。
所以单位时间里的劳动量没有那么夸张。
他的话让二人频频颔首。
这是个进可攻，退可守的开垦量。
若是后续人口扩张，随时可按季度扩大耕种规模。
如果扩张度不足，所产出的粮食不仅能满足领地消耗，还会有不少结余。
当然，他们所参照的是庄园自营地的精耕标准。
这个标准在罗德看来，其实也仍有很大的进步空间。
“领地耕牛、犁具和农具不足的问题，务必在秋播前解决掉。”
说完他立刻看向五大三粗的格兰·米尔斯。
“格兰师傅，明日你的首要任务就是让铁匠工坊复工并扩大规模，原先的铁匠铺肯定无法满足需求。”
“城东追随而来的铁匠和学徒们将作为工坊班底。”
“全力铸造重型铁犁。”
大多数常用的农具，罗德都带了现成的。
邦城工坊出品的农夫铁器三件套，他足足携带了800套。
按照农业单元划分，这些农具绰绰有余。
这次他携带的物资庞大。
否则也不需要由多艘海船共同参与运输了。
两千多个农奴搬运都花了大半天。
罗德停顿片刻，旋即补充道。
“这次我们要铸造的犁具比南域所用的铁犁更重。”
南域铁犁总重多在18到22斤。
犁铧和犁壁是主要的铁部件，差不多重约8~10斤。
罗德以前就跟格兰师傅讨论过几套设计方案。
考虑到黑滩镇的土地情况和深耕需求。
计划中犁铧的重量要比南方铁犁重出30%以上。
犁铧刃部要进行额外的包钢。
重犁将会增加耕牛所耗费的劳力。
所以饲料支出也得提高。
但深耕之后的种植效果必然要比现在好得多。
他这次来一共携带了将近二十吨铁锭。

;;
Thought for a moment.
Rhodes raised his pen and wrote the word "farmland" on the arrow to the west.
Then he looked at Charles and Bryce seriously.
“My idea is to cultivate 5,000 to 7,000 acres of land intensively throughout the year.”
All fields are cultivated separately according to the planting season.
Therefore, the amount of labor per unit time is not that exaggerated.
His words made the two of them nod frequently.
This is a reclamation amount that can be attacked when advancing and defended when retreating.
If the population expands subsequently, the farming scale can be expanded at any time on a quarterly basis.
If the expansion is insufficient, the food produced will not only meet the consumption of the territory, but also have a lot of surplus.
Of course, what they refer to is the intensive farming standard of the manor’s own camp.
In Rhode's view, this standard actually still has a lot of room for improvement.
"The problem of insufficient plows, plows and agricultural tools in the territory must be solved before autumn sowing."
After saying that, he immediately looked at the tall and tall Glen Mills.
"Master Gran, your first task tomorrow is to resume work and expand the blacksmith workshop. The original blacksmith shop will definitely not be able to meet the demand."
"The blacksmiths and apprentices from the east of the city will serve as the workshop team."
"Forging the heavy iron plow with all your might."
Rhodes brought ready-made most of the commonly used farm tools.
He carried a total of 800 sets of farmer's ironware three-piece sets produced by Bangcheng Workshop.
According to the agricultural unit division, these agricultural tools are more than enough.
The supplies he carried this time were huge.
Otherwise, there is no need for multiple sea-going ships to participate in transportation.
It took most of the day to move more than two thousand serfs.
Rhodes paused for a moment and then added.
"The plows we are going to cast this time are heavier than the iron plows used in the Southern Region."
The total weight of the iron plows in the Southern Region ranges from 18 to 22 kilograms.
The plowshare and plowboard are the main iron parts, weighing about 8 to 10 kilograms.
Rhodes had discussed several design plans with Master Gran before.
Taking into account the land conditions and deep cultivation needs of Heitan Town.
The planned weight of the plowshare is more than 30% heavier than that of the Southern Iron Plow.
The plowshare blade needs to be additionally covered with steel.
Heavy plowing will increase the amount of labor expended by the oxen.
Therefore, feed expenses must also increase.
But the planting effect after deep plowing will definitely be much better than now.
He brought a total of nearly twenty tons of iron ingots this time.
